page_title: WER 0-4 BAY | Werder Bremen v Bayern Munich 18/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+4' 0 - 4 Goal - 0:4! Alphonso Davies tees up Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) inside the box and he curls the ball into the left side of the net and past Jiri Pavlenka.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' 0 - 3 Goal! Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) finishes from close range with an easy finish and he makes it 0:3. He was ably assisted there by Thomas Muller.
89' Matthijs de Ligt (Bayern Munich) was too forceful with his tackle and Felix Zwayer interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
88' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Felix Zwayer who sees an offensive foul.
86' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner which is cleared.
85' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jiri Pavlenka intercepts the ball.
84' Substitution. Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) in, Kingsley Coman out.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) comes onto the pitch for Harry Kane.
84' Thomas Tuchel has decided to substitute Jamal Musiala and he is replaced by Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich).
81' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) picks up an injury.
79' Here comes a substitution. Leon Goretzka is given a rest as he is replaced by Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich).
79' Here is a change. Anthony Jung is going off and Ole Werner gives the last tactical orders to Leon Opitz (Werder Bremen).
79' The game has come to an end for Jens Stage. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Dawid Kownacki (Werder Bremen).
77' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) trips an opposition player and Felix Zwayer signals a foul.

74' 0 - 2 Stunning strike! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) latches on to a precise through ball from Alphonso Davies before unleashing an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner from the edge of the area. Fantastic goal. The score is now 0:2.
74' Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Felix Zwayer blows for a foul.
70' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar.
68' That's the end of the game for Leonardo Bittencourt, who is replaced by Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen).
68' Ole Werner prepares a substitution. Senne Lynen is replaced by Christian Gross (Werder Bremen).
68' That will be all from Min-Jae Kim who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Matthijs de Ligt (Bayern Munich).
67' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) has a first-time shot at goal. It's a good effort from the edge of the box, but flies just a whisker past the right post.
66' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) brings an opponent down and Felix Zwayer interrupts the game.
66' Bayern Munich seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
65' A lofted cross from Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
63' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Harry Kane.
63' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post.
62' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.

61' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Jiri Pavlenka is well positioned to make a comfortable save. Bayern Munich will take a corner kick.
61' A long pass, executed by Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen), missed the precision to reach his teammates.

60' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
59' Substitution. Mitchell Weiser walks off the pitch and Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) comes on as a substitute.
59' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) expertly controls a neat clever pass on the edge of the penalty area, but his effort smashes against the right post! What a shot that was!
58' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
57' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
56' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) gets a yellow card.
55' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) was quite harsh and Felix Zwayer didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
53' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.

53' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bayern Munich.
52' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
49' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
48' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
48' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.

47' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Jiri Pavlenka pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
47' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies slightly over, almost brushing the crossbar.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
45+3' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Bayern Munich earn a corner.
45+2' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
45+1' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Felix Zwayer saw the whole situation.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His low header flies toward the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
45' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
45' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. It will be a corner kick for Bayern Munich.
44' Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
41' It will be a free kick from the middle of the park. Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is looking around and deciding who will be the best choice to start a new attack with.
41' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender.
40' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
39' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for a foul.

39' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
35' Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.

34' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the left post. Jiri Pavlenka pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
33' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
32' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends a cross into the box, but Jiri Pavlenka comes off his line to gather the ball.
30' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
29' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
28' Looks like Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
25' The corner kick from Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
24' Felix Zwayer blows the whistle, Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) is penalised for a foul.
23' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the left post only for Sven Ulreich to dive and make a save.
22' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick to Werder Bremen.
22' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) but poses no threat.
21' Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the left post. Close!
20' Felix Zwayer shows a yellow card to Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) for his blatant foul.

19' What a chance that is! Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
16' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Sven Ulreich, who smothers the ball.
14' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
13' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.

11' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Felix Zwayer stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Bayern Munich are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
8' The goal by Werder Bremen won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
8' The Werder Bremen players halt their celebrations as referee Felix Zwayer makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
8' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) brings his opponent down. Felix Zwayer has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Werder Bremen.
6' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
4' 0 - 1 Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) finds himself one-on-one with the keeper after a great pass by Harry Kane. He takes the shot early and scores!
3' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Kingsley Coman.
3' It looks like Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) saw red with that tackle. Felix Zwayer won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.

Bayern Munich will kick the game off.
Felix Zwayer will officiate today.
